identity.title: Controlled Research Profile Enforcement
identity.objective: Correct the merged WP175H external Hermes runtime so pristine pinned Hermes v0.21.3 runs under one mechanically enforced controlled research profile: remove --safe-mode from the real research invocation (it sets HERMES_SAFE_MODE=1 and suppresses the bundled Firecrawl backend H1 requires) while retaining --ignore-user-config and --ignore-rules, and replace the lost isolation with a deterministic repo-owned non-secret managed-scope config.yaml injected through an ephemeral HERMES_MANAGED_DIR that pins Firecrawl for web_search and web_extract, forces keyless fallback/rescue and web cache off, empties the provider fallback chain, sets one ordinary provider attempt (agent.api_max_retries 1), forbids the custom/user/project plugin allow-list while pinned bundled backend discovery still registers Firecrawl, and adds a fail-closed research-home control-plane preflight; all with zero real provider, OAuth, Firecrawl-secret, web-research, capital, or order activity and no dependency, lock, or workflow change.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert WP175I. Only the controlled research profile correction is removed: the policy safe-mode removal and managed-scope config construction, the runner ephemeral managed-dir plus research-home control-plane preflight, the controller managed-config wiring, the package export additions, the three focused test additions, the WP175I status/spec/prompt, the runtime contract profile section, and the scoped docs/repo-truth/deferred and status-doc-guard registrations. Pinned Hermes v0.21.3 stays unchanged and no dependency, workflow, credential, account, order, paper, Gate-C, WP176, or live state exists to unwind; the pre-WP175I safe-mode research invocation returns and no other module changes behavior.

api_matrix.reason: WP175I changes the external Hermes runtime posture from safe-mode to a controlled managed-scope profile while preserving the dormant no-authority boundary; the public surfaces gain profile-enforcement behavior only.

items.before: Research argv carried --safe-mode and the policy froze safe_mode true
items.after: Research argv omits --safe-mode (retains --ignore-user-config/--ignore-rules); the policy freezes safe_mode false, adds controlled managed-scope profile fields, and derives deterministic managed-config bytes whose SHA-256 is committed into the policy identity (schema bumped to 2.0.0)
items.compatibility_requirement: No caller may re-enable safe mode as the H1 safety layer, broaden toolsets, or alter any pinned managed backend/fallback/retry/plugin value without failing construction or changing policy identity

items.before: One ephemeral empty cwd, minimal env, optional safe research HERMES_HOME
items.after: Adds a distinct ephemeral managed-scope directory whose config.yaml is the deterministic managed bytes, sets HERMES_MANAGED_DIR itself (never inherited), never forwards HERMES_SAFE_MODE/HERMES_ENABLE_PROJECT_PLUGINS, removes both ephemeral directories on every path, and fails closed before spawn when the research home carries a config.yaml or non-empty user plugins
items.compatibility_requirement: The managed dir and cwd are distinct ephemeral paths outside repo/local_data/home; no secret value is read or echoed; tests use a fake executable and make zero paid/provider/network calls

items.after: Controller builds the deterministic managed-config bytes from the policy and hands them to the single backend invocation; expected_hermes_contract surfaces the controlled-profile facts for evidence
items.compatibility_requirement: Exactly one backend invocation; the controller writes no config to disk and sets no environment variable; receipt/provider/model/cost/schema/safety gates are unchanged

items.after: Also records the deterministic managed-config bytes it was handed while still performing zero process and zero network calls
items.compatibility_requirement: The fake never writes the config to disk or sets an environment variable and records the controlled policy input deterministically

semantic_fields.reason: The controlled research profile pins safe-mode removal, managed-scope Firecrawl/keyless/fallback/retry values, the managed-config digest identity, the bounded transport recovery, the plugin boundary, and the research-home control-plane, each with explicit fail-closed semantics verified against exact tagged v0.21.3 commit 345cd2b.

evidence_plan.reason: R001-R025 cover the safe-mode removal, retained ignore flags, exact web toolset, managed-config determinism/content/digest-identity, ephemeral managed-scope isolation and cleanup, ambient-env non-forwarding, research-home control-plane preflight, single controller invocation, bounded-recovery truthfulness, no forbidden imports, docs truth, and the local/hosted validation.

items.expected_result: the default controlled policy freezes safe_mode false with controlled_managed_scope true and re-enabling safe mode fails policy construction
the research argv omits --safe-mode, retains exactly --ignore-user-config and --ignore-rules and one --toolsets web, and carries no unsupported flag
the research argv never contains --max-turns, --format, stream-json, --input-file, chat, or --oneshot
re-enabling safe mode, disabling the ignore flags or controlled managed scope, or altering any pinned managed backend/keyless/fallback/retry/plugin/recovery value fails policy construction
the managed-config bytes are deterministic canonical sorted JSON stable across constructions and equal to the module constant
the managed config pins web backend, search_backend, and extract_backend to firecrawl with provider_tier firecrawl paid
the managed config sets web keyless_fallback, keyless_rescue, and cache_enabled all false
the managed config sets fallback_providers to the empty list
the managed config sets agent.api_max_retries to exactly 1
the managed config sets plugins.enabled empty, hooks empty, and updates.check false
the managed config carries no secret-looking content and no traversal, absolute, or private path when scanned with the request secret and path patterns
the managed-config SHA-256 appears in the policy identity fields and the policy id is the hash of those fields
the external backend creates a distinct ephemeral cwd and managed dir and the child reads the deterministic managed config from HERMES_MANAGED_DIR
an ambient HERMES_MANAGED_DIR is never forwarded and the child sees only the backend-created ephemeral managed dir
ambient HERMES_SAFE_MODE, HERMES_ENABLE_PROJECT_PLUGINS, and provider-secret env vars are never forwarded to the child
the ephemeral managed and cwd directories are removed after a successful invocation
a research home carrying a config.yaml fails the control-plane preflight and the invocation launch-fails before any process starts
a research home with a non-empty user plugins directory fails the control-plane preflight before spawn
a research home with only an .env/auth.json credential store and an empty plugins directory is permitted and no secret value is read or echoed
the controller invokes the backend exactly once and hands it the deterministic controlled managed-config bytes

the policy truthfully records same-provider primary transport recovery ALLOWED_BOUNDED, provider/model fallback NONE, web fallback/rescue NONE, custom plugin loading FORBIDDEN, and bundled backend discovery allowed for web provider registration
the runtime package imports no execution_gateway, paper_trading, oms, risk, or private-account/network surface

project status, the WP175I status entry, and the runtime contract truthfully record WP175H merged, the safe-mode removal, the controlled managed profile, the prior H1 failure with zero real calls, and the separately gated S10-GATE-H1 successor
